initiatives.name: Battle Creek Pride
initiatives.description: An LGBTQ+ organization in Battle Creek, Michigan that runs the city's Pride events, a resource center, career services, and community groups.

initiatives.name:
Battle Creek Coalition for Truth, Racial Healing, and
              Transformation
initiatives.description: Our vision is to see Battle Creek flourish as a community where all individuals can enjoy a shared humanity, and our mission is to act as the catalyst for a racial equity movement.

initiatives.name: Voces
initiatives.description: Voces is a warm and inviting space where the LatinX community of greater Battle Creek and Southwest Michigan can come together and receive empowering support in several different ways.
